text:
Liam T.: ping — customer `GreenCart` flagged at amber: onboarding stalled (3/7), avg session tokens down 35% wk/wk, renewal in 19 days. suggest a light-touch rescue play: quick probes, micro-fix, short enablement, downgrade opt-in if needed.

Rhea P.: agree. prefer fast wins first. can we run automated probes and apply nondisruptive config changes in a 48h window?

Gio M.: yes. proposed sequence: 1) telemetry + audit, 2) Tier 1 auto-fixes (cache, batching), 3) 20-min enablement + eval, 4) downgradesafe opt-in with credits. keep each step <72h.

SupportBot: uploaded recent support log: https://support.internal/greencart/777 (4 timeout errors, 2 webhook failures).

Liam T.: quick audit highlights: p50=0.9s (baseline 0.7s), p95=3.1s, KV hit 48%, 12 webhook retries last 24h. looks like cache + webhook backoff problem.

Rhea P.: Tier 1 actions (0-48h):
```
- bump cache ttl 8s -> 60s for onboarding route
- enable prefix_kv for onboarding prompts
- set webhook retry limit=4 with exponential jitter
- small-batch mode (batch_size=6) for heavy routes
- enable 5% canary traffic for 6h
```
Apply sequentially and monitor p95 + errors.

Gio M.: I'll stage the canary and run smoke checks. also prepare a rollback flag.

Liam T.: outreach snippet for customer (short):
"Hi GreenCart — we noticed onboarding paused. We rolled a small perf tweak that frequently resolves timeouts. Can we do a 20-min sync or send async notes?"

Ops: reminder set -> review canary metrics in 6h for thread 3337778889.

Gio M.: pushed cache + prefix_kv to staging, saw KV hit -> 71% and p95 improved ~600ms. started 5% canary in prod.

Rhea P.: scheduled 20-min enablement (Mon 9am PT). will include prompt templates and a short eval run.

Liam T.: Tier 2 (3-7d) if Tier 1 doesn't meet goals:
- 20-min enablement & prompt tuning session
- 100-shot eval vs quantized candidate (compare semantic sim + hallucination incidents)
- offer temporary reduced-concurrency API key + 20% usage credit for 30 days if they want to opt-in

Gio M.: note: quantized model lowers cost but slightly higher hallucination on edge cases. we'll run regen=1,temp=0.2 tests and present results.

Rhea P.: UI copy for opt-in: "Temporarily reduce concurrency and receive 20% usage credit for 30 days. Revert anytime from Settings." keep it simple.

Liam T.: rollback snippet for flags:
```
# revert fallback route and disable canary
flags.enable('greencart_normal_route')
deploy --canary=0
```

Gio M.: canary metrics after 4h: errors down 70% in canary cohort, p95 = 1.5s. continuing monitor.

Liam T.: outcome goal: restore active sessions to within 10% of baseline or secure opt-in downgrade with credits + clear rollback. CSM to escalate to renewals if unresolved by renewal -7d.

Rhea P.: I'll capture feedback during enablement and add notes to the playbook page.

SupportBot: follow-up scheduled in 48h for thread 3337778889.

Gio M.: will upload eval report and the dashboard widgets to the playbook. will ping when done.

Liam T.: thanks team — tagging this as "light-touch-rescue" in playbook index. closing after follow-up. :white_check_mark:
